integrity: The theorem has a self-contained prime-power and Möbius-inversion proof. Code performs exact finite checks only. No independent external validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Gcd of positive-index coefficients only: the constant terms of the quasimodular forms are generally rational and are not included. The result is not a congruence on a prescribed progression or a factorization algorithm. Full originality against all unindexed literature is not established.
title: Exact coefficient content of prime-detecting divisor-sum forms
